data_manager_tool.name: miRge3 Library Manager
data_manager_tool.description: download and install miRge3 reference libraries
data_manager_tool.command:
#set $lib_path = $__tool_directory__ + '/../../tool-data/mirge3_libraries/' + str($organism) + '_' + str($mir_db)
mkdir -p '$lib_path' &&
## Download the library from SourceForge wget -q 'https://sourceforge.net/projects/mirge3/files/Libraries/${organism}_${mir_db}.tar.gz/download' -O library.tar.gz &&
tar -xzf library.tar.gz -C '$lib_path' &&
## Write the data table entry echo -e "${organism}_${mir_db}\t${lib_path}\t${organism}" >> '${output}'
data_manager_tool.help:
# miRge3 Library Manager
Downloads and installs organism-specific reference libraries for miRge3.0.
Libraries are downloaded from the miRge3 SourceForge repository and contain: - Bowtie indexes for miRNA hairpin sequences - Mature miRNA annotations - Genomic coordinates for isomiR analysis - tRNA reference sequences (human only)
Each library is approximately 1-2 GB in size.
